implementation_summary.authoring_model: normalizeLessonDraft(input) returns a discriminated union. Success path yields AuthoringLesson { id, title, phases[] } with stable, position-derived IDs at lesson/phase/section/activity level. Failure path yields structured errors with { path, message }. Enforces: at least one phase, at least one section per phase, at least one activity per section, and componentKey membership in canonical SCHEMA_REGISTRY (so placeholder keys equation-solver and drag-drop-categorization are rejected, as is any unknown key).
implementation_summary.activity_config_validation: validateActivityConfig(componentKey, props) binds validation to the key via getPropsSchema(componentKey) from @math-platform/math-content/schemas. Rejects missing-required-field, empty-arrays-where-disallowed, cross-key props, placeholder keys, and unknown keys. Errors are { componentKey, path: string[], message } so downstream surfaces (composer UI, approval queue) can render the failing field. safeParse is used so the caller's props object is never mutated.
implementation_summary.sanitize_authored_text: sanitizeAuthoringText strips <script>/<style> blocks (and their content), event-handler attributes (on*=), and javascript: URL prefixes. Math notation ($, **, ^, _), markdown emphasis, and literal text inside benign tags are preserved. sanitizeLessonDraft walks the full draft and rewrites every string leaf so the Phase 2 hash sees sanitized content. SanitizedText renders sanitized text as a plain text node (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML) so authored content cannot execute when surfaced in the Phase 3 composer UI.
